rows.sub_bound: input-referred offset, 3 sigma, calibration-free, at every PVT point
rows.condition: whole latch (comparator_dut), differential axis at dut_vcm = 0.6 V; no common-mode claim (DR-0002 'What this record does not ratify')
rows.statistical_basis:
Monte Carlo over SG13G2's shipped per-instance local-mismatch models (mos_

_mismatch sections), N = 60 draws per PVT point, base seed 20260916 (DR-0002 Row 1: whole-latch bench N = 60, seed 20260916, sigma precision +/-9.1 %); the row is met only if the WORST point meets it
rows.klt_window_note: klt's own per-corner window (|mean| + 3 x Bessel sample sigma, raw quantized values) is a stricter statistic than DR-0002's; reported, not graded. 33/45 points pass it.

rows.sub_bound: differential, input-referred, total integrated rms; compliance path = whole-latch transient-noise decision statistics with seeds and run counts committed
rows.condition: TRNOISE-injected transient decision statistics on comparator_dut, N = 80 trials per rung per PVT point, 3 rungs; DR-designated statistic = grid-wide mean of the per-point two-rung probit-slope sigma (+/-13 % per-corner scatter at N = 80)
rows.statistical_basis: transient-noise decision statistics (DR-0002 Row 2); the .noise figure on the reduced sub-model is a reportable lower bound only, never compliance

target.statistic: grid-wide mean of the per-point two-rung probit-slope sigma

stretch.statistic: grid-wide mean of the per-point two-rung probit-slope sigma

retained_record.format: this repo's append-only record format (not a klt envelope)
retained_record.recorded_value: grid-wide mean implied 1-sigma decision noise 1.335 mV (per-point 0.889 ... 2.710 mV), 45/45 points, N = 80 per rung
retained_record.binding: grid-wide mean (the DR-designated statistic); worst single point tt_125c_1.08v (2.710 mV)

rows.tool_gap: 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#2960 (no gradeable population statistic over two measurements / per-corner populations); #2963 (the Monte-Carlo seed contract does not cover TRNOISE: draws are pid-seeded, so separate batch jobs can share noise streams); see also #2482 (one analysis per corner)
notes: 1401/3600 samples repeat a raw noise draw also seen at ANOTHER grid point (never within one point). Each point's estimate is valid and unbiased; the points are not mutually independent, so the grid mean's sampling error is wider than an independent-points estimate (bounded above by the per-point error if fully correlated).

rows.sub_bound: decision time at 50 mV overdrive, 1.2 V core, at every PVT point
rows.condition: 33.3 MHz strobe, delay measured on the second strobe (output must flip a latch holding the opposite answer), thresholds supply-normalized
rows.statistical_basis:
deterministic corner matrix, mismatch off (plain mos_

sections)

rows.sub_bound: regeneration time constant tau, worst PVT point, tau = (t(0.1 mV) - t(1 mV)) / ln 10
rows.condition: extracted from the (1 mV, 0.1 mV) delay pair of the regeneration bench

rows.sub_bound: decision time at 0.1 mV overdrive, worst PVT point
peak transient injected charge per decision edge, per side: Q_kick = max_t |integral of i_kick dt'| over 30 ... 45 ns, referenced to the node's pre-decision level at 29 ns
rows.condition: branch A of the kickback bench: input node driven from an ideal source through R_src = 1 kohm with C_in = 100 fF to ground; NOT the net settled charge on the floating branch (a different, ~8x smaller quantity)
rows.statistical_basis: deterministic corner matrix, mismatch off; worst side (max of + and - input) per point

rows.sub_bound: signal-dependent differential residue at the input nodes at the end of a 30 ns decision cycle, against a non-charge-restoring source
rows.condition: branches B and C (1 Gohm / 1 pF, RC = 1 ms): difference between the settled differential input displacement at a 1 mV and a 100 mV input, 29 ns -> 55 ns (DR-0002 key kick_sigdep)

rows.sub_bound: peak single-ended excursion into the stated 1 kohm / 100 fF drive -- a REPORTING requirement, deliberately unbounded until a driving stage is named
rows.condition: branch A, v(apa) - v(asp), max |.| over 30 ... 45 ns

rows.sub_bound: 1.2 V +/-10 % LV core, -40 ... 125 C: every implemented bench exercised over the full grid, with the supply and temperature verified as applied
rows.condition: supply 1.08 / 1.20 / 1.32 V, temperature -40 / 27 / 125 C, process tt/ff/ss/fs/sf

rows.sub_bound: average power at 33.3 MHz, INCLUDING the tail-bias reference branch
rows.condition: instance A of the regeneration bench on its own supply (core + its own dut_ib reference branch), average supply power over one full 30 ns cycle (30 ... 60 ns) containing one decision that flips the held output
